about: Real rows of the 2026-10-12 P3 dry run and the real gemma-4-E4B answers stage 2 of the over-fill A/B recorded for them (repeat 1 of the `current` and `placebo` arms), with the two arms' prompts from plan.json and, per row, the sha256 of the prompt stage 2 sent (the harness's own render()). Read by tests/test_annotation_agreement.py. Rows copied verbatim from each store. Since 2026-10-15 each row gets two more calls, for record_change only: call 3 sends the re-check's `cf` prompt (current + the record_change block) and call 4 its `pf` (placebo + the block), plan.json of overfill/ab_runs/cfpf_20261015_075611: cfpfPrompts, per row cfpfPromptSha256 (same render, same hash) and answers.cf / answers.pf (repeat 1 of that run).

current.system:
You annotate one eligibility criterion of a clinical trial protocol.

The criterion has already been extracted from a line of the protocol, and you do not change any extracted field. You read that protocol line and record the facts the fields below define about the criterion, each together with the fragment of the protocol line that states it.

Every fragment you return is copied from the protocol line character for character: no paraphrase, no expanded abbreviation, no added word. A fragment that does not occur in the protocol line is discarded together with the answer it supports.

Return one JSON object and nothing else.
current.userTemplate:
Protocol line:
{protocol_line}

Extracted criterion:
- Role: {role}
- Entity text: {entity_text}
- Description: {description}
- Domain: {domain}
- Logic type: {logic_type}
- Window: {window}
- Value constraint: {value_constraint}
- Group label: {group_label}
- Members: {members}

Fields to return:

`record_requirement` states what this criterion asks of the patient's record of the entity it names, as the protocol line states it. One of:
- `required`: the patient meets the criterion only if a record of the entity exists.
- `forbidden`: the patient meets the criterion only if no record of the entity exists.
- `conditional`: the line applies the criterion only to patients who already have a record of the entity, or who belong to a subgroup the line names; a patient without that record or outside that subgroup is not filtered by this criterion at all.

`conditional_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that limits the criterion to those patients. It is required when `record_requirement` is `conditional` and null otherwise.

`excepted_entities` lists the entities the protocol line explicitly removes from the set that this criterion's entity names, one entry per removed entity: `text` is the name of the removed entity to look up in a clinical vocabulary, and `span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names it. It is an empty list when the line removes nothing from that set.

`base_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names the set the excepted entities are removed from. It is required when `excepted_entities` is not empty and null otherwise.

`relation` states how the protocol line combines the members listed above into this criterion, read without the criterion's logic type. One of:
- `all`: the criterion holds only when every member holds.
- `any`: the criterion holds when at least one member holds.
- `at_least`: the criterion holds when at least a stated number of members hold.
It is null when the criterion has no members.

`relation_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states how the members combine. It is required when `relation` is not null and null otherwise.

`cardinality` is the stated number of members, as an integer, when `relation` is `at_least`, and null otherwise.

`timing` states when, relative to the patient's entry into the trial, the protocol line places what this criterion describes. One of:
- `prior`: before entry.
- `at_index`: at entry.
- `prospective`: after entry, as something planned or expected to happen.

`window_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that places the criterion in time. It is required when `timing` is `prospective`; otherwise it is that fragment when the line states one, and null when the line does not.

`route` lists the routes of administration the protocol line restricts this criterion's drug to. Each entry is one of the route values a clinical vocabulary attaches to drug dose forms: {route_values}. A value covers the routes the vocabulary files under it: `topical` covers `transdermal`, and `respiratory_tract` covers `nasal`. When the line restricts the drug by where in the body it acts rather than by naming a route, list every route value by which a drug of that kind acts there. The list holds the single value `any` when the line places no restriction on route, and when the criterion's entity is not a drug.

`route_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the route restriction. It is required when `route` is not `any` and null otherwise.

`specimen` states the body material in which the protocol line says the quantity this criterion measures is taken. One of:
- `blood`: blood, or a fraction separated from blood.
- `urine`: urine.
- `other`: a body material that is neither blood nor urine.
- `any`: the line names no body material, or the criterion measures no quantity.

`specimen_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names the body material. It is required when `specimen` is not `any` and null otherwise.

`no_entity` states whether the protocol line names, for this criterion, a clinical entity that a clinical vocabulary could hold. One of:
- `none`: the line names such an entity.
- `refers_elsewhere`: the line names no such entity and identifies what the criterion is about only by pointing elsewhere: to an item, list, table or appendix of the protocol, or to a product known only by its role in a study.
- `investigator_judgement`: the line names no such entity and leaves the criterion to the investigator's assessment.

`no_entity_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that points elsewhere or states the assessment. It is required when `no_entity` is not `none` and null otherwise.

`threshold_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the numeric threshold this criterion compares its own entity against: the comparison, the number, and the unit or the reference limit, as written. It is null when the line states no numeric threshold for this criterion's entity.

`quantity_kind` states what the number in `threshold_span` measures. One of:
- `lab_value`: a value that a laboratory test or a clinical measurement records for the patient.
- `dose`: an amount of a drug that is given, taken or prescribed.
- `duration`: how long a condition, a treatment or a state has lasted or must last.
- `count`: a number of events, of episodes, or of listed items that must hold.
- `statistical`: a quantity of the trial's statistical design rather than of the patient.
- `other`: any other quantity.
It is null when `threshold_span` is null.

`reference_bound` states what the number in `threshold_span` is compared against. One of:
- `uln`: a multiple of the upper limit of the normal range of the laboratory that measured it.
- `lln`: a multiple of the lower limit of the normal range of the laboratory that measured it.
- `none`: the number itself, in the unit that `threshold_span` states.
It is null when `threshold_span` is null.

Output JSON:
{{"record_requirement": "<required|forbidden|conditional>", "conditional_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "excepted_entities": [{{"text": "<entity name>", "span": "<fragment of the protocol line>"}}], "base_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "relation": "<all|any|at_least, or null>", "relation_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "cardinality": "<integer, or null>", "timing": "<prior|at_index|prospective>", "window_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "route": ["<route value or any>"], "route_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "specimen": "<blood|urine|other|any>", "specimen_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "no_entity": "<none|refers_elsewhere|investigator_judgement>", "no_entity_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "threshold_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "quantity_kind": "<lab_value|dose|duration|count|statistical|other, or null>", "reference_bound": "<uln|lln|none, or null>"}}

cf.system:
You annotate one eligibility criterion of a clinical trial protocol.

The criterion has already been extracted from a line of the protocol, and you do not change any extracted field. You read that protocol line and record the facts the fields below define about the criterion, each together with the fragment of the protocol line that states it.

Every fragment you return is copied from the protocol line character for character: no paraphrase, no expanded abbreviation, no added word. A fragment that does not occur in the protocol line is discarded together with the answer it supports.

Return one JSON object and nothing else.
cf.userTemplate:
Protocol line:
{protocol_line}

Extracted criterion:
- Role: {role}
- Entity text: {entity_text}
- Description: {description}
- Domain: {domain}
- Logic type: {logic_type}
- Window: {window}
- Value constraint: {value_constraint}
- Group label: {group_label}
- Members: {members}

Fields to return:

`record_requirement` states what this criterion asks of the patient's record of the entity it names, as the protocol line states it. One of:
- `required`: the patient meets the criterion only if a record of the entity exists.
- `forbidden`: the patient meets the criterion only if no record of the entity exists.
- `conditional`: the line applies the criterion only to patients who already have a record of the entity, or who belong to a subgroup the line names; a patient without that record or outside that subgroup is not filtered by this criterion at all.

`conditional_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that limits the criterion to those patients. It is required when `record_requirement` is `conditional` and null otherwise.

`excepted_entities` lists the entities the protocol line explicitly removes from the set that this criterion's entity names, one entry per removed entity: `text` is the name of the removed entity to look up in a clinical vocabulary, and `span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names it. It is an empty list when the line removes nothing from that set.

`base_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names the set the excepted entities are removed from. It is required when `excepted_entities` is not empty and null otherwise.

`relation` states how the protocol line combines the members listed above into this criterion, read without the criterion's logic type. One of:
- `all`: the criterion holds only when every member holds.
- `any`: the criterion holds when at least one member holds.
- `at_least`: the criterion holds when at least a stated number of members hold.
It is null when the criterion has no members.

`relation_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states how the members combine. It is required when `relation` is not null and null otherwise.

`cardinality` is the stated number of members, as an integer, when `relation` is `at_least`, and null otherwise.

`timing` states when, relative to the patient's entry into the trial, the protocol line places what this criterion describes. One of:
- `prior`: before entry.
- `at_index`: at entry.
- `prospective`: after entry, as something planned or expected to happen.

`window_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that places the criterion in time. It is required when `timing` is `prospective`; otherwise it is that fragment when the line states one, and null when the line does not.

`record_change` states whether the protocol line requires the patient's records of this criterion's entity to stay the same, or to change, across a period that the line states. One of:
- `stable`: the line requires those records to stay the same across that period.
- `changed`: the line requires those records to change across that period.
- `none`: the line requires neither.
A requirement that the entity be present, or have been present, for a length of time states a duration, not records that stay the same or change. The name of a disease, a condition or a finding is the entity itself, even where the name describes how it runs over time, and states no requirement on the records.

`record_change_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the requirement. It is required when `record_change` is not `none` and null otherwise.

`route` lists the routes of administration the protocol line restricts this criterion's drug to. Each entry is one of the route values a clinical vocabulary attaches to drug dose forms: {route_values}. A value covers the routes the vocabulary files under it: `topical` covers `transdermal`, and `respiratory_tract` covers `nasal`. When the line restricts the drug by where in the body it acts rather than by naming a route, list every route value by which a drug of that kind acts there. The list holds the single value `any` when the line places no restriction on route, and when the criterion's entity is not a drug.

`route_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the route restriction. It is required when `route` is not `any` and null otherwise.

`specimen` states the body material in which the protocol line says the quantity this criterion measures is taken. One of:
- `blood`: blood, or a fraction separated from blood.
- `urine`: urine.
- `other`: a body material that is neither blood nor urine.
- `any`: the line names no body material, or the criterion measures no quantity.

`specimen_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names the body material. It is required when `specimen` is not `any` and null otherwise.

`no_entity` states whether the protocol line names, for this criterion, a clinical entity that a clinical vocabulary could hold. One of:
- `none`: the line names such an entity.
- `refers_elsewhere`: the line names no such entity and identifies what the criterion is about only by pointing elsewhere: to an item, list, table or appendix of the protocol, or to a product known only by its role in a study.
- `investigator_judgement`: the line names no such entity and leaves the criterion to the investigator's assessment.

`no_entity_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that points elsewhere or states the assessment. It is required when `no_entity` is not `none` and null otherwise.

`threshold_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the numeric threshold this criterion compares its own entity against: the comparison, the number, and the unit or the reference limit, as written. It is null when the line states no numeric threshold for this criterion's entity.

`quantity_kind` states what the number in `threshold_span` measures. One of:
- `lab_value`: a value that a laboratory test or a clinical measurement records for the patient.
- `dose`: an amount of a drug that is given, taken or prescribed.
- `duration`: how long a condition, a treatment or a state has lasted or must last.
- `count`: a number of events, of episodes, or of listed items that must hold.
- `statistical`: a quantity of the trial's statistical design rather than of the patient.
- `other`: any other quantity.
It is null when `threshold_span` is null.

`reference_bound` states what the number in `threshold_span` is compared against. One of:
- `uln`: a multiple of the upper limit of the normal range of the laboratory that measured it.
- `lln`: a multiple of the lower limit of the normal range of the laboratory that measured it.
- `none`: the number itself, in the unit that `threshold_span` states.
It is null when `threshold_span` is null.

pf.system:
You annotate one eligibility criterion of a clinical trial protocol.

The criterion was already extracted from one line of the protocol, and no extracted field is yours to change. You read that protocol line and record the facts that the fields below define about the criterion, each one with the fragment of the protocol line that states it.

Every fragment you return is copied from the protocol line character for character: no paraphrase, no expanded abbreviation, no added word. A fragment that does not occur in the protocol line is discarded together with the answer it supports.

Return one JSON object and nothing else.
pf.userTemplate:
Protocol line:
{protocol_line}

Extracted criterion:
- Role: {role}
- Entity text: {entity_text}
- Description: {description}
- Domain: {domain}
- Logic type: {logic_type}
- Window: {window}
- Value constraint: {value_constraint}
- Group label: {group_label}
- Members: {members}

Fields to return:

`record_requirement` states what this criterion asks of the patient's record of the entity it names, as the protocol line states it. One of:
- `required`: the patient meets the criterion only if a record of the entity exists.
- `forbidden`: the patient meets the criterion only if no record of the entity exists.
- `conditional`: the protocol line restricts the criterion to patients who already have a record of the entity, or to patients in a subgroup that the line names; this criterion does not filter a patient who lacks that record or is not in that subgroup.

`conditional_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that restricts the criterion to those patients. It is required when `record_requirement` is `conditional`, and null in every other case.

`excepted_entities` lists, one entry for each, the entities that the protocol line explicitly removes from the set named by this criterion's entity: `text` is the removed entity's name to look up in a clinical vocabulary, and `span` is the fragment of the protocol line naming it. When the line removes nothing from that set, it is an empty list.

`base_span` is the fragment of the protocol line naming the set from which the excepted entities are removed. It is required when `excepted_entities` is not empty, and null in every other case.

`relation` states how the protocol line combines the members listed above into this criterion, read without the criterion's logic type. One of:
- `all`: the criterion holds only when every member holds.
- `any`: the criterion holds when at least one member holds.
- `at_least`: the criterion holds when at least a stated number of members hold.
It is null when the criterion has no members.

`relation_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states how the members combine. It is required when `relation` is not null and null otherwise.

`cardinality` is the stated number of members, as an integer, when `relation` is `at_least`, and null otherwise.

`timing` states when, relative to the patient's entry into the trial, the protocol line places what this criterion describes. One of:
- `prior`: before entry.
- `at_index`: at entry.
- `prospective`: after entry, as something planned or expected to happen.

`window_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that places the criterion in time. It is required when `timing` is `prospective`; otherwise it is that fragment when the line states one, and null when the line does not.

`record_change` states whether the protocol line requires the patient's records of this criterion's entity to stay the same, or to change, across a period that the line states. One of:
- `stable`: the line requires those records to stay the same across that period.
- `changed`: the line requires those records to change across that period.
- `none`: the line requires neither.
A requirement that the entity be present, or have been present, for a length of time states a duration, not records that stay the same or change. The name of a disease, a condition or a finding is the entity itself, even where the name describes how it runs over time, and states no requirement on the records.

`record_change_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the requirement. It is required when `record_change` is not `none` and null otherwise.

`route` lists the routes of administration the protocol line restricts this criterion's drug to. Each entry is one of the route values a clinical vocabulary attaches to drug dose forms: {route_values}. A value covers the routes the vocabulary files under it: `topical` covers `transdermal`, and `respiratory_tract` covers `nasal`. When the line restricts the drug by where in the body it acts rather than by naming a route, list every route value by which a drug of that kind acts there. The list holds the single value `any` when the line places no restriction on route, and when the criterion's entity is not a drug.

`route_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the route restriction. It is required when `route` is not `any` and null otherwise.

`specimen` states the body material in which the protocol line says the quantity this criterion measures is taken. One of:
- `blood`: blood, or a fraction separated from blood.
- `urine`: urine.
- `other`: a body material that is neither blood nor urine.
- `any`: the line names no body material, or the criterion measures no quantity.

`specimen_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that names the body material. It is required when `specimen` is not `any` and null otherwise.

`no_entity` states whether, for this criterion, the protocol line names a clinical entity that could be held in a clinical vocabulary. One of:
- `none`: such an entity is named by the line.
- `refers_elsewhere`: no such entity is named by the line, which identifies what the criterion concerns only by pointing elsewhere: to an item, a list, a table or an appendix of the protocol, or to a product known only by its role in a study.
- `investigator_judgement`: no such entity is named by the line, which leaves the criterion to the assessment of the investigator.

`no_entity_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that points elsewhere or states the assessment. It is required when `no_entity` is not `none` and null otherwise.

`threshold_span` is the fragment of the protocol line that states the numeric threshold this criterion compares its own entity against: the comparison, the number, and the unit or the reference limit, as written. It is null when the line states no numeric threshold for this criterion's entity.

`quantity_kind` states what the number in `threshold_span` measures. One of:
- `lab_value`: a value that a laboratory test or a clinical measurement records for the patient.
- `dose`: an amount of a drug that is given, taken or prescribed.
- `duration`: how long a condition, a treatment or a state has lasted or must last.
- `count`: a number of events, of episodes, or of listed items that must hold.
- `statistical`: a quantity of the trial's statistical design rather than of the patient.
- `other`: any other quantity.
It is null when `threshold_span` is null.

`reference_bound` states what the number in `threshold_span` is compared against. One of:
- `uln`: a multiple of the upper limit of the normal range of the laboratory that measured it.
- `lln`: a multiple of the lower limit of the normal range of the laboratory that measured it.
- `none`: the number itself, in the unit that `threshold_span` states.
It is null when `threshold_span` is null.

{{"record_requirement": "<required|forbidden|conditional>", "conditional_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "excepted_entities": [{{"text": "<entity name>", "span": "<fragment of the protocol line>"}}], "base_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "relation": "<all|any|at_least, or null>", "relation_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "cardinality": "<integer, or null>", "timing": "<prior|at_index|prospective>", "window_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "record_change": "<stable|changed|none>", "record_change_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "route": ["<route value or any>"], "route_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "specimen": "<blood|urine|other|any>", "specimen_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "no_entity": "<none|refers_elsewhere|investigator_judgement>", "no_entity_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "threshold_span": "<fragment of the protocol line, or null>", "quantity_kind": "<lab_value|dose|duration|count|statistical|other, or null>", "reference_bound": "<uln|lln|none, or null>"}}
